meaning:
ἐν-τροπή, -ῆς, ἡ
[in LXX: Job.20:3, Psa.35:26 44:15 69:7, 19 71:13 109:29 (כְּלִמָּה)* ;]
1. with genitive of person(s), respect, reverence (Soph., Polyb., al.).
2. Absol., shame (Hipp.): 1Co.6:5 15:34.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: I say this to move you to shame. Isn’t there even one wise man among you who would be able to decide between his brothers?
